answer: Each identity lodges one jade bead in its haven vault and posts a 70-credit bond. A checker puts it on a velvet stage, measures its refraction angle, and recomputes it from the jade refraction table. A reading off by over 2 percent, a reused serial, or one key with two beads burns the bond. The first costs 31 credits; the kth fake costs 31+9(k-1), so the 1000th costs 9022 and 1000 fakes cost 4,526,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-bead ring fails: each serial is tied to one haven slot, so reuse burns its bond. An honest agent pays 31 once and recovers its bond.
